title: caltha palustris subsp. violacea
intro: Caltha palustris subsp. violacea, commonly known as Marsh Marigold, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the buttercup family Ranunculaceae. The plant is used for its medicinal properties and is known to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antibacterial effects, which can help in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Marigold include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
